correctness.rationale: From actual RESULT.md, the order polytope indicator is log-supermodular under coordinate min/max, so continuous FKG association applied first conditionally in X and then to F_i(Y_i) yields q(P)>=2^-n, strictly when a pair of coordinates is poset-comparable. Conditional on two linear extensions, the common order-statistic interleavings satisfying X<=Y form a subset of Catalan ballot words; different extensions exclude the alternating ballot word. Hence q<=1/(n+1), strict unless unique extension (chain). Comparing volumes of O(P×C2) and O(P)² yields e(P×C2)/(binom(2n,n)e(P)²); conditioning on star tops yields (p+1)2^(p-1)(p!)²/(2p+1)! and stated Stirling asymptotic. Independently recomputed all 75 forward-oriented relation subsets up to 4 points and five stars by exact integer extension DP; these finite checks do not prove all-poset assertions.
residual_risks: Proof invokes continuous FKG theorem for associated uniform order-polytope law; this is a standard published tool, not independently reproved.
